content.short: ADA Underworld is a CNFT collection on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
ADA Underworld is a CNFT collection of unique and hand-drawn artworks. Each one is stored as a Non-Fungible Token ("NFT") on the Cardano blockchain. In our first set we are releasing 750 randomly generated 2D Devils. All the assets used in creating each devil vary in rarity. There are millions of different combinations. The rarity chart of an upcoming series will be published on the day of the release. We are also creating a COMIC which will be released pre-mint. 15 special edition NFTs have been made that will only be obtainable through giveaways. Those characters will be featured in our comic. This is a community-driven project that keeps on rewarding our holders. Join now for teasers, giveaways, contests, special events, whitelist spots and more.

The mythical creatures of the Underworld, a place of unforgiving shadows, had transformed themselves into awakened multidimensional beings. Thus fully merging the fourth and fifth dimensions into the third. But then something happened...

This new post-catastrophic world has sparked some grave tensions between the nations, progressing so far that they are now preparing for the great clash of the Underworld. These beings of light are now emerging severally from the darkness. The first to appear are the Devils!
